facts.claim: 开篇用摩斯码做双关：道歉写成点划就是 remorse code，remorse 与 morse 只差一个音。
facts.quote: What do you call an apology written in dots and dashes? Remorse code.

facts.claim: 「人形电脑」的绰号理由与算力无关，而是独处十分钟就睡着，把 computer 按「会休眠的机器」字面解。
facts.quote: My nickname is ‘the human computer’. Not because I’m smart, but because I go to sleep if left alone for ten minutes.

facts.claim: 爱尔兰双重验证的笑话，用 to be sure, to be sure 的口头重复去对应 two-factor 的「两重」。
facts.quote: Why does Irish technology involve two-factor authorization? To be sure, to be sure.

facts.claim: 电脑进酒吧付不出钱，用 cleared my cache 同时表示「清空缓存」和「没钱」。
facts.quote: A computer walks into a bar and orders a drink. The barman says, ‘That’ll be £5 please.’ ‘Sorry,’ says the computer, ‘I’ve cleared my cache.’

facts.claim: 作者把系统提示「密码不安全」读成人格上的缺乏自信，归因于密码规则太苛刻。
facts.quote: My computer keeps saying my password is insecure. Perhaps if it wasn’t constantly forced to adhere to ridiculously strict requirements it would have a bit more confidence.

facts.claim: 监控笑话里，吸尘器 gathering dirt 既指吸尘又指多年收集把柄，比手机和电脑更「阴」。
facts.quote: Sure, your phone and computer spy on you all the time, but they’re not the worst. Your hoover has been gathering dirt on you for years.

facts.claim: 章末把「调颜色」听成地名：先被反问 Brighton，再用 Worthing 把要对比度的话接回去。
facts.quote: ‘Can you adjust the colours on this picture of a town on the south coast of England please?’ ‘Brighton?’ ‘No, I just need an increase in contrast on this image of Worthing.’

relations.relation: 只改一个音就同时塞进「道歉」与「摩斯码」两个意思，是章节标题「need a reboot」式旧技术梗的开场。
relations.quote: What do you call an apology written in dots and dashes? Remorse code.

relations.pair: cleared my cache / 付不出钱
relations.relation: 计算机术语被当成人的经济状况来解释，技术动作与生活动作共用同一个短语。
relations.quote: ‘Sorry,’ says the computer, ‘I’ve cleared my cache.’

relations.relation: 两个南岸地名轮换出现：Brighton 是误听的结果，Worthing 才把「提高对比度」的原意说回来。
relations.quote: ‘Brighton?’ ‘No, I just need an increase in contrast on this image of Worthing.’

relations.pair: human computer / 会休眠的机器
relations.relation: 绰号的依据从「算得快」挪到「闲置就睡」，把褒义称号换成了自嘲。
relations.quote: Not because I’m smart, but because I go to sleep if left alone for ten minutes.

numbers.meaning: 酒吧报出的价钱，是电脑回答「清空缓存」的前置数目。
1023 兆字节差一步到 1GB，所以这支乐队「没到 gig 级」，gig 兼指演出。
numbers.quote: There’s a new band called 1023 Megabytes. They’re good but not at gig level.

numbers.meaning: 独处十分钟就会睡着，这是「人形电脑」唯一的依据。
numbers.quote: but because I go to sleep if left alone for ten minutes

numbers.meaning: 时间机器饿了就回退四秒，相当于「再来一份」。
numbers.quote: What does a time machine do when it’s hungry? Goes back four seconds.
